items.text: delivery person nahi mil raha
address galat lag raha hai
call utha nahi rahe
haan ji
thik hai
kal tak

items.context: Kya delivery person se baat ho pa rahi hai?
items.text: haan ji

items.context: Aapko delivery boy kaunsa number mila hai?
items.text: nahi mil raha

items.context: Kya woh aapko delivery time confirm kar paaye?
items.text: shaam tak pahunch jayega
delivery wala call nahi utha raha hai
mai abhi tak address par khada hu par koi nahi mil raha
kya aap driver se contact kar sakte hai please
phone par baat karne ki koshish ki par nahi ho rahi
mera order number ek do zero four five six hai
kya aap address dobara confirm kar sakte hain driver ke liye
main market ke paas hotel par khada hu jo bataya tha address me

items.context: Kya driver ne address confirm kiya hai aap se?
items.text: haan sir driver abhi road par hai bol raha hai driver ko dhund rahe hai

items.context: Kya address me koi problem lag rahi hai?
items.text: driver ne kaha hai ki building ka naam clear nahi hua hai

items.context: Kya delivery boy se contact ho pa raha hai?
items.text: driver ka phone number do baar call kiya but answer nahi diya

items.context: Kya aap address verify kar sakte hain?
items.text: haan mai phir se address confirm karke aapko batata hu

items.context: Kya aapne delivery guy ko call kiya hai?
items.text: thoda ruka hu abhi, so raha hoga shayad call karne par
mai thodi der se yahan wait kar raha hu par delivery wala phone utha nahi raha hai ab tak
address to thik hai aur main exact location bhi bata raha hu lekin delivery person samajh nahi pa raha
mera order 25 april ko book hua tha aur delivery mein bahut der ho rahi hai mujhe status batayein please

items.context: Kya aap bata sakte hain ki delivery boy abhi kahaan hai?
items.text: aap delivery person se baat kar ke bata sakte hain ki wo kahaan phansa hua hai

items.context: Kya aap address confirm kar chuke hain?
items.text: address to maine verify kar liya hai, kya aapke paas koi aur contact number hai delivery ke liye

items.context: Kya thoda aur detail me address bata sakte hain?
items.text: mai parking ke saamne khada hu hotel ke paas lekin driver thoda confuse hai is location ko samajhne me

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: agent_unreachable - the delivery person is not answering or cannot find the address
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
